submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 19 (Cr0.33Sb0.67) had the highest EQE at 0.0153%. Its composition is close to the CrSb2O6 trirutile stoichiometry. EQE rose as Sb content increased: -0.0024% at 26% Sb and 0.0045% at 49% Sb. XRD was not measured, so the phase was not confirmed.
